Messages.Author: meneran
Messages.Body:
Hello,

When I use Contraband to equip with AK-47 (5 pool cost equipment), are both of these scenarios correct?
A: I first reduce the cost (using The Shard) of the AK-47 by 2 pool, then I choose to pay the remaining 3 pool cost by using 1 blood and 2 pool (by Contraband text)
B: I choose to pay AK-47 by using 2 blood and 3 pool (Contraband text), then I reduce the 3 pool cost by 2 pool (using Shard), resulting in payment of 1 pool and 2 blood.
Card texts:

Contraband
Only usable before range is determined. A vampire can play only one Contraband each combat.
[obf]: Equip this vampire with a non-unique equipment from your hand (requirements and cost apply as normal).
[OBF]: As above, and this vampire can pay up to half the cost rounded down of that equipment with their blood.

The Shard
Unique location.
If you have the Edge, you can lock this card to reduce the cost of a card you play by 2 pool or blood. Vampires can steal this location as a Ⓓ action; Ventrue get +1 stealth during that action.

Messages.Author: Coyote
Messages.Body:
This is not an official response.
First, you need to calculate the cost of the card.
Then, decide how to pay.
The Shard modifies the cost. It's applied first.
Then you decide how to pay the cost. (with or without blood and how much)

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> meneran wrote:
> Hello,
>
> When I use Contraband to equip with AK-47 (5 pool cost equipment), are both of these scenarios correct?
> A: I first reduce the cost (using The Shard) of the AK-47 by 2 pool, then I choose to pay the remaining 3 pool cost by using 1 blood and 2 pool (by Contraband text)
> B: I choose to pay AK-47 by using 2 blood and 3 pool (Contraband text), then I reduce the 3 pool cost by 2 pool (using Shard), resulting in payment of 1 pool and 2 blood.
>
A) only.

1. First, you declare the cost of the card. You can use effects such as The Shard to reduce the cost.
2. When paying for the card, you can choose how to pay.

Since Contraband resolves as played, 1/ and 2/ are done together, in that order.

For actions cards, 1/ can be done when announcing the action, in order to announce an action that wouldn't be otherwise possible (and 2/ when actually paying for the card, that is at resolution).
